Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.physics

Class PhysicsObject

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.physics.PhysicsObject
Direct Known Subclasses:
FixedPoint, PhysicsBody, PhysicsParticle
public abstract class PhysicsObject extends Object
The basic abstract class for all phyiscally simulated objects. This is the base class all classes that represents objects that the physics enginge can move around should inherit from.
